# A beach towel lying on the sand: 2.2 x 1.1 m, pink and white stripes (textures/towel.png).
new
material new Towel --base-color 1 1 1 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Towel --size 1 --location 0 0 0.04
scale 2.2 1.1 0.08
apply --scale
material assign Towel
active Towel
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
select all
uv project-from-view top --scale-to-bounds
mode object
material texture Towel base-color textures/towel.png
select all
shade flat
export towel.glb
